svg.aria-label: Day 3 hero: Sample essay 4.1 is taken apart into coloured strips — background, BUT issue, SO position, counter-argument, reason 1 and reason 2 — while a student on the beach cheers and a big magnifying glass looks closer. A balance weighs green achievements against heavier red problems. Around it: a rainforest, palms, a sea turtle and a coral reef, and on a wooden deck a seminar presenter with a “Green jobs” slide.
